100     def search(
101         self,
102         query: str,
103         limit: int = 3,
104         score_threshold: float = 0.35,
105     ) -> List[Any]:
106         params = {"query": query, "limit": limit, "output_format": "v1.1"}
107         if user_id := self._get_user_id():
108             params["user_id"] = user_id
109 
110         agent_name = self._get_agent_name()
111         if self.memory_type == "short_term":
112             params["agent_id"] = agent_name
113             params["metadata"] = {"type": "short_term"}
114         elif self.memory_type == "long_term":
115             params["agent_id"] = agent_name
116             params["metadata"] = {"type": "long_term"}
117         elif self.memory_type == "entities":
118             params["agent_id"] = agent_name
119             params["metadata"] = {"type": "entity"}
120         elif self.memory_type == "external":
121             params["agent_id"] = agent_name
122             params["metadata"] = {"type": "external"}
123 
124         # Discard the filters for now since we create the filters
125         # automatically when the crew is created.
126         if isinstance(self.memory, Memory):
127             del params["metadata"], params["output_format"]
128             
129         results = self.memory.search(**params)
130         return [r for r in results["results"] if r["score"] >= score_threshold]

132     def _get_user_id(self) -> str:

135     def _get_agent_name(self) -> str:

139         agents = self.crew.agents

141         agents = "_".join(agents)
